title: Povo - Polo Ferrari geographic blockout v0.1
status: Geographic and gameplay blockout source; CS2 validation is recorded separately

coordinate_transform.declared_horizontal_crs: EPSG:25832 per PAT tile index; source lineage ETRF2000 epoch 2008.0 / ETRS89
coordinate_transform.declared_vertical_datum: ITALGEO 2005 orthometric metres per PAT metadata
coordinate_transform.formula: local = source - origin; no reprojection, scaling, rotation, or datum conversion

terrain.boundary_rule: Keep all outer sample rows and columns; last interval may be shorter
terrain.uv_formula: u=(easting-west)/(east-west); v=(northing-south)/(north-south), using full orthophoto bounds
terrain.uv_orientation: OBJ v=0 south / image bottom; v=1 north / image top

Same north core envelope; east side of open courtyard.
North end of approximate roof ring.
South end of approximate roof ring.
Approximate south core envelope; median DBM roof sample for main south block.
Same south core envelope; east side of open courtyard.

boundary.reason: Segmented perimeter walls make the first-playable east forecourt explicit and follow the sloping DTM without creating one oversized floating wall.

cover.reason: Full-height cover interrupts the western south-to-site sightline.
Low cover supports a second eastern approach without duplicating the western lane.
Central chest-height cover creates a disengagement point before the objective.
Offset central cover prevents a direct spawn-to-spawn sightline through the east lane.
Low cover mirrors the south-east option while preserving asymmetric terrain.
Full-height cover interrupts the eastern north-to-site sightline.

calibration.purpose: Staging-only scale check outside the campus; delete before game packaging

attribution.terrain_and_building_heights: Derived from LiDAR DTM/DBM PAT 2014 / 2018, Provincia Autonoma di Trento - Servizio Geologico, CC BY 4.0. Cropped, subsampled, translated to local coordinates; building roof heights summarized and volumes approximated.
attribution.orthophoto: Comune di Trento, Ortofoto 2024, flight 28-29 August 2024, CC0 1.0 Universal. Resampled WMS extract used for geographic reference and approximate roof-envelope tracing.

config_note: A 200 x 300 m survey blockout containing a compact east-forecourt Wingman envelope. Rectangular modules approximate roof envelopes inspected in the 2024 municipal orthophoto and PAT DBM. These are not cadastral footprints or architectural measurements. Courtyard gaps are retained. Heights summarize mixed-date roof surfaces; base levels are buried construction assumptions. The bridge slab thickness is assumed. Gameplay cover and boundaries are explicit design additions rather than measured campus features. No interiors, openings, stairs or CS2 entities are authored here.
limitations: Rectangular building modules are approximate volumes, not surveyed footprints or architectural models.
Roof elevations and buried bases come from explicit configuration; DBM is checked for grid alignment, not automatically interpreted.
The orthophoto is a reference overlay: aerial roofs remain visible on underlying ground; this is not a finished ground texture.
Outer cell edges are not mesh vertices. NoData triangles and coarse quads spanning hidden NoData are omitted.
DTM decimation cannot establish walkable steps, ramps, entrances, or retaining-wall geometry.
No interiors, navigation, lighting bake, CS2 entities, or compiled map are provided by this geographic builder.

configuration.assumptions: Exterior detail pass based on user-reviewed photographs. Existing approximate module footprints and DBM roof heights are retained. Cardinal facade assignment, exact bay counts, window dimensions and floor levels are design estimates, not measurements. Opaque panel placeholders do not create breakable glass or access to interiors. The bridge roof follows the previous DBM estimate; its deck is estimated 3.2 m below the roof.

facades.placement_note: Street-facing appearance from P002; assigning this treatment to the module east face and using a continuous 42-bay grid are approximate.
Courtyard glass treatment. Exact setbacks, doors, stairs and bay interruptions have not been reconstructed.
Return of the glass facade inferred from overall exterior views; count and exact south-face placement remain approximate.
Light stone and narrow-window rhythm visible in the reviewed photographs; uniform three-row treatment and exact elevations are estimates.
P003 is user-labelled as facing the internal building. Applying its stone/window language to this courtyard-facing module is an approximate placement, not a confirmed camera pose.
Stone piers and vertical windows inferred from Povo 2 exterior views. Bay count and storey elevations are provisional.
Courtyard-facing application of the reviewed Povo 2 material language; exact facade geometry and floor levels are unmeasured.
Glass annex appearance confirmed as Povo 2; exact correspondence to this footprint and panel count are still approximate.

bridge.placement_note: Replace the old solid reference slab with a visual deck, roof, posts and horizontal louvers. Roof elevation follows the existing DBM estimate; deck, clearance and structural spacing are assumptions. This is scenery outside arena collision, not a verified accessible route.
